articles.headline: India's October Trade Deficit Hits One-Year High
articles.brief: India's trade deficit reached a one-year high of $39.88 billion in October, driven largely by a sharp surge in gold imports and robust economic demand.

articles.headline: BYD Launches Luxury Denza Brand in India
articles.brief: Electric vehicle manufacturer BYD has introduced its luxury brand Denza to the Indian market, positioning itself to compete directly with established luxury automakers like Mercedes and Toyota.

articles.headline: Delhi Becomes World's Most Polluted City
articles.brief: Air quality levels in India's capital have plummeted, causing Delhi to surpass Lahore as the world's most polluted city amidst worsening seasonal smog.

articles.headline: Global Microsoft Outage Disrupts Businesses Worldwide
articles.brief: A massive global technical outage has severely disrupted Microsoft services including Outlook and Teams across more than 70 countries, leaving millions without access for nearly 18 hours.

articles.headline: New Orleans River Cruise Boat Collides with Tanker
articles.brief: A large commercial tanker collided with a docked river cruise boat in New Orleans on the Mississippi River, causing partial sinking and triggering urgent emergency rescue operations.

articles.headline: Urgent Climate Finance Pleas Face Slow COP31 Response
articles.brief: Delegates at COP31 face sluggish responses to urgent climate finance requests as political priorities shift in Western governments and ongoing global conflicts inflate security spending.

articles.headline: Gambhir Highlights Concerns Over India's Batting Collapses
articles.brief: Indian cricket coach Gautam Gambhir has expressed strong concerns regarding recurring batting collapses following low scores ahead of the upcoming international World Cup fixtures.

articles.headline: CAG Launches Two-Year Audit on Urea Diversion
articles.brief: The Comptroller and Auditor General has initiated an extensive two-year audit across 169 districts to trace urea consumption patterns and eliminate massive agricultural subsidy leakages.

articles.headline: Modi Heads to Manila for ASEAN-India Summit
articles.brief: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is traveling to Manila for the ASEAN-India Summit to expand economic cooperation and navigate regional trade imbalances amid rising Chinese geopolitical clout.

articles.headline: US Assures India of Favorable Tariffs in Trade Deal
articles.brief: United States trade officials have reportedly assured India of preferential tariff structures compared to regional peers, signaling a breakthrough in bilateral trade negotiations.

articles.headline: Turkey and Qatar Sign Mutual Defence Agreement
articles.brief: Turkey and Qatar have formalized a strategic mutual defense pact, strengthening their military and security cooperation in the volatile West Asian geopolitical landscape.

articles.headline: US Grounds All Departing Flights Over Safety Concerns
articles.brief: Federal aviation authorities in the United States have ordered a temporary grounding of all departing flights nationwide due to extraordinary safety and security concerns.

articles.headline: Nvidia Approached Arm CEO Haas to Succeed Huang
articles.brief: Financial reports indicate that Nvidia recently approached Arm Chief Executive Rene Haas to potentially succeed Jensen Huang as the chip giant's leader.
